Name: Pet Bowl Filler
Author: invatorzen
Description:
[center]﻿[/center][center][img]https://i.imgur.com/j63ywq2.png[/img]

﻿[/center][center]This was another [url=https://github.com/StardewModders/mod-ideas/issues/806]request[/url]﻿, but also a mod that already existed and just kind of needed a little update. (Perfect for me since I wanted to learn how to SMAPI mod!)
Original mod is [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2009?tab=description]pet water bowl[/url]﻿ by [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/51622381]Mizzion

[/url]This mod gives the user some options:
* Daily filling
* ﻿Rain/Storm filling
* Snow filling
* Sprinkler filling

They are relatively self explanatory, but daily filling will fill the bowl every morning, rain/storm fills it during rain and thunderstorms, snow will fill when it snows and sprinkler will fill the bowl with all types of sprinklers (as long as it's in range!)[/center]

Downloads.Description: Fills the pet bowl based on your config settings. MCM not supported yet, so you have to manually do them.

Manifest.Name: Pet Bowl Filler
Manifest.Description: This mod fills the pet bowls every morning.
